title: Thinking Orbs
concept: Halyard, a passage-planning assistant for small-boat sailors, whose live planning console maps each real phase (voice brief, tide lookup, window planning, route drawing, brief writing) to one of the six thinking-orb states, with a light chartroom view that shows theme="auto" flipping the ink.
notes: React islands using the installed thinking-orbs 0.3.2 package. Sticks to the skill's six documented states and the tuned 20/64 sizes, monochrome (no color prop). Orbs are aria-hidden next to role=status text; the orb is removed when the brief is ready; reduced motion is handled by the library's static frame.
